description: With nothing outstanding, an ACK-ONLY whose RX LWE passes Test 4 but whose bitmap acknowledges an FSN fails Test 5, and a FULL RESET starts.
note: Link setup and round trip as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip (Caller): FSN 0 is acknowledged at 126000, so TX LWE 1 and TX UWE 0: nothing outstanding. At 131000 the peer's ACK-ONLY carries RX LWE 1 and one bitmap byte 01, acknowledging FSN RX LWE + 1 = 2 (C-0233, C-0250). Test 4 passes (RX LWE 1 on the arc from TX LWE 1 to TX UWE + 1 = 1, C-0800), but Test 5 fails: with nothing outstanding no acknowledged FSN is in sync (C-0801, C-0786). The D_PDU is not used (C-1170) and a FULL RESET starts (C-0791, C-0792): FULL RESET CMD, RESET FRAME ID 0 (C-1173), sent at 181000 after the predicted end 136000 and contention 45000. dts.reset_wait runs from 186550 (C-1172), and the peer's FULL RESET ACK at 191000 stops it. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Transmissions are zero filled: fill is P4-3's.
